claim: A target-near D18:CS4:BTP-eC9 ternary reports different relative T80 advantages under 65 C aging and continuous illumination, so durability evidence must remain stress-mode-specific and cannot be collapsed into one generic lifetime claim.

source.title: Central Molecular Stacking Regulator Boosts the Efficiency of Organic Solar Cells

inputs.uncertainty_note: No formal uncertainty is supplied in the accessible primary-source abstract; none is invented.
No formal uncertainty is supplied in the accessible primary-source abstract; none is invented. Illumination spectrum/intensity/temperature/encapsulation details are not inferred here.

correction_history: Pre-PR independent recomputation corrected an initially transcribed ratio_of_ratios value of 1.6133720930232558 to 1.613849765258216. Source T80 inputs and scientific decision were unchanged.
validity_domain: Descriptive comparison of the two reported D18:CS4-based systems under each named stress mode only. Not a D18:PY-IT:eC9 lifetime, field lifetime, acceleration model, or project acceptance threshold.
falsifier: The benchmark is falsified if the cited primary source does not report the stated T80 values for the stated systems/stress modes, or if independently recomputed ratios disagree beyond the frozen numerical tolerance.
next_physical_discriminator: Measure blinded B0/B1/B2 target chemistry under separately preregistered thermal and continuous-light durability conditions while tracking stabilized Pmax and mechanism-retention observables.
